web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.title: A shared future starts with a thoughtful beginning.
web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.intro: A happy family begins long before a wedding. It begins with two people having the space to understand one another, choose freely, and imagine a future they both want. That is the idea at the heart of Favorite Hearts.
web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.s1.te: Favorite Hearts is being built around a simple hope: to make life less lonely by bringing people together to build happy families. Our focus is matrimony for Sri Lankans at home and abroad.
web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.s2.ti: A choice that belongs to you
web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.s2.te: Marriage is a personal decision. Family support can be valuable, but an introduction should always leave room for the wishes, boundaries, and pace of the people involved.
web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.s3.te: Our Mission page shares the values behind this vision. Favorite Labs shares ideas about shared values and lasting partnerships.
web.article.a-thoughtful-beginning.summa: Favorite Hearts aims to make life less lonely by helping people build happy families. Our approach to matrimony puts personal choice first, welcomes thoughtful family support, and makes space for each person’s boundaries and pace.
web.article.matrimony-with-more-heart.ti: The experience we want to build: matrimony with more heart.
web.article.matrimony-with-more-heart.in: Finding a person to build a life with deserves a thoughtful experience. We are shaping Favorite Hearts around meaningful introductions, honest conversations, and the everyday realities of marriage.
web.article.matrimony-with-more-heart.s1: Our product vision begins with people who are considering marriage. We want the experience to make room for personality, practical expectations, and the future each person hopes to build.
web.article.matrimony-with-more-heart.s2: A thoughtful profile should help someone understand who is behind it, what matters to the candidate, and what kind of partnership they are seeking. Clarity matters when a family member helps manage an introduction.
web.article.matrimony-with-more-heart.s3: These principles guide the experience we are developing. We will share specific feature announcements here as they are ready.
web.article.matrimony-with-more-heart.su: We are building a matrimony experience around clear intentions, honest profiles, and meaningful introductions. Our goal is to help people understand one another and the future they hope to share, with clarity about any family member’s role.
web.article.respect-in-every-introductio: Respect is part of every introduction.
Feeling comfortable matters from the very first conversation. Respect shows up in small choices: asking instead of assuming, listening without pressure, and accepting the other person’s boundaries.
Let a conversation be a choice
An introduction is an invitation, not an obligation. Both people should feel free to take their time, set boundaries, or decide not to continue.
Keep sensitive documents and financial details private. Do not send money to someone you have only met online. If you arrange a first meeting, choose a public place and tell someone you trust.
If an interaction feels pressuring or unwelcome, you can step away. A respectful connection makes space for a no without arguing, repeated requests, or guilt.

Every introduction should leave both people free to choose. Respect boundaries, share personal information carefully, avoid sending money to someone you have only met online, and step away from pressure. Plan first meetings in public and keep someone you trust informed.
web.article.belonging-across-borders.int: Home can mean a place, a language, a tradition, or the people who understand you. For Sri Lankans around the world, a shared future can bring more than one idea of home together.
Sri Lankan lives span different countries, languages, beliefs, and family traditions. Our vision makes room for that variety rather than assuming everyone wants the same future.
People can cherish family and culture while making their own decisions about marriage. We believe those conversations deserve patience and respect.
We want to encourage more thoughtful introductions and a sense of possibility across communities. This is an aspiration guiding our work, rather than a claim of measured social impact.
web.article.belonging-across-borders.sum: There is more than one way to feel at home or build a family. Our vision welcomes the variety of Sri Lankan lives around the world, with room for cultural traditions, personal choice, and thoughtful introductions across communities.
web.article.beyond-the-checklist.title: Beyond the checklist: what does a shared life look like?
web.article.beyond-the-checklist.intro: A list of preferences can help you begin. Getting to know a person means looking beyond it. Talking about an ordinary life together can reveal the questions that matter most to each of you.
web.article.beyond-the-checklist.s1.text: Imagine a weekday together, not only the wedding. Where would you live? How would work, family time, and responsibilities fit into the day? Use that picture to begin a conversation.
web.article.beyond-the-checklist.s2.text: Separate your essentials from your preferences. A shared approach to kindness or family responsibilities may matter differently to you than the same hobbies. Explain your priorities without turning the conversation into a test.
web.article.beyond-the-checklist.s3.text: Ask what a good life means to the other person. You do not need identical answers, but you do need space to discuss the differences honestly.
web.article.beyond-the-checklist.summary: Look beyond a list of preferences and talk about everyday life together. Explain what matters most to you, ask what a good life means to the other person, and make room to explore differences without turning the conversation into a test.
web.article.a-first-conversation.title: A first conversation that feels like you.
web.article.a-first-conversation.intro: You do not need a perfect opening line. A little curiosity, a personal detail, and room for the other person to answer can make an introduction feel more natural.
web.article.a-first-conversation.s1.text: Share a small detail from your week and ask about theirs. A conversation can be intentional without feeling like an interview.
web.article.a-first-conversation.s2.titl: Ask one question at a time
web.article.a-first-conversation.s2.text: Try “What are you looking forward to this year?” or “What makes somewhere feel like home to you?” Listen to the answer before deciding what to ask next.
web.article.a-first-conversation.s3.text: If you would like to talk again, say so simply. Let the other person choose freely, and respect their pace or their decision not to continue.
web.article.a-first-conversation.summary: Begin with something real, ask one question at a time, and listen with curiosity. You can be intentional without making an introduction feel like an interview. Let any next step be a mutual choice.
web.article.family-and-your-voice.title: Family can be part of the journey. Your voice comes first.
web.article.family-and-your-voice.intro: Family can bring warmth and perspective to an introduction. The people considering marriage still need space to discover what they want, in their own words and at their own pace.
web.article.family-and-your-voice.s1.tex: Let your family know what would help: finding introductions, thinking through questions, or simply listening. Be clear about which decisions you want to make yourself.
web.article.family-and-your-voice.s2.tex: Talk about timelines and preferences before an introduction. If expectations differ, try explaining your reasons rather than only stating a rule.
web.article.family-and-your-voice.s3.tex: Family enthusiasm is not a substitute for your own willingness. A decision about marriage should leave both people free to say yes, no, or that they need more time.
web.article.family-and-your-voice.summar: Family support can be valuable, but your voice and willingness come first. Explain the support you want, discuss expectations openly, and protect both people’s freedom to say yes, no, or ask for more time.
web.article.across-borders-on-the-same-p: Across borders, on the same page.
A connection across countries can begin with shared roots. Building a future together also means talking openly about distance, expectations, and where each of you hopes life will lead.
Ask where each person hopes to live and how close they want to be to family. Do not assume that a move abroad or a return to Sri Lanka is part of the plan.
Time zones, travel, careers, and caring responsibilities deserve a place in the conversation. It is fine to have questions that cannot be answered immediately.
Agree on a way to stay in touch that works for both people. If you plan to meet, choose a public place and keep someone you trust informed.

A shared future across countries needs honest conversations about home, careers, travel, and family responsibilities. Avoid assumptions about relocation, agree on a realistic way to stay in touch, and plan any first meeting with care.
web.article.before-marriage.title: The little things worth talking about before marriage.
web.article.before-marriage.intro: A wedding is one occasion. A marriage is made up of ordinary days. Conversations about those days can help two people understand what partnership would mean to them.
web.article.before-marriage.s1.title: Think beyond the big occasion
web.article.before-marriage.s1.text: Discuss everyday responsibilities, time alone, friendships, and how you like to spend weekends. These details make the idea of a shared life more concrete.
web.article.before-marriage.s2.title: Make room for differences
web.article.before-marriage.s2.text: One person may need time to think; another may want to talk immediately. Ask how each of you prefers to approach a disagreement instead of expecting the same style.
web.article.before-marriage.s3.title: Keep the conversation open
web.article.before-marriage.s3.text: You will not settle every question in one sitting. Return to the topics that matter as you get to know each other, without rushing a decision.
web.article.before-marriage.summary: Talk about the ordinary days as well as the wedding: responsibilities, friendships, time alone, and how you handle disagreements. You do not need every answer immediately. Keep learning about one another without rushing the decision.
web.article.an-honest-profile.title: A thoughtful introduction starts with an honest profile.
web.article.an-honest-profile.intro: A profile is a starting point for a conversation. It does not need to tell your whole story or make your life look perfect. It should give someone an honest glimpse of the person behind it.
web.article.an-honest-profile.s1.title: Describe your actual life
web.article.an-honest-profile.s1.text: Write about a few things that matter to you, what you enjoy, and the future you hope for. Specific, honest details give another person something to ask about.
web.article.an-honest-profile.s2.title: Be clear about intentions
web.article.an-honest-profile.s2.text: Say what you are looking for in a partnership. If a parent or another person manages the profile, make that role clear and keep the candidate’s wishes central.
web.article.an-honest-profile.s3.title: Share with care
web.article.an-honest-profile.s3.text: Being open does not require publishing private contact or identity details. Save sensitive information for an appropriate stage, and only share what you feel comfortable sharing.
web.article.an-honest-profile.summary: An honest profile offers a clear glimpse of your life and intentions. Share specific details, make any profile manager’s role clear, and keep the candidate’s wishes central. Being open does not require sharing sensitive personal information.

web.mission.title: Our Mission
web.mission.description: Our mission is to make life less lonely by bringing people together to build happy families: the values behind every Favorite Hearts introduction.
web.mission.headline: We want to make life less lonely
web.mission.byBringingPeopleTogether: By bringing people together to build happy families
web.mission.marriageIsDeeplyPersonal: Marriage is deeply personal. These are the values we want at the heart of every introduction, every conversation, and every choice.
web.mission.thereIsMoreTo: There is more to you than a checklist. Your hopes, beliefs, little habits, and big dreams all deserve a place in your story.
web.mission.familyCanBePart: Family can be part of the journey. The choice belongs to you. A lasting partnership begins with two people who want to be there.
web.mission.behindEveryProfileIs: Behind every profile is a person. Listen openly, respect boundaries, and give each other the kindness an important decision deserves.
web.mission.aFewSimpleBeliefs: A few simple beliefs guide the experience we’re creating.
web.mission.sharedValuesExpectationsAnd: Shared values, expectations, and hopes for marriage make a more meaningful starting point than a perfect photograph.
web.mission.careersCulturesFamiliesAnd: Careers, cultures, families, and distance all shape a relationship. Bring the whole picture into the conversation.
web.mission.aConnectionShouldGrow: A connection should grow at a pace that feels right to both people. There is no deadline for feeling comfortable.
web.mission.aThoughtfulIntroductionCan: A thoughtful introduction can open a door. Only you can decide who you want to walk through it with.
web.mission.weBelieveAnIntroduction: We believe an introduction should make room for personality, values, and everyday life — as well as the practical things that matter when considering marriage.
web.mission.whatDoesAShared: What does a shared future look like to you? From family and faith to work and where to call home, the important conversations deserve to happen early.
web.mission.supportFromLovedOnes: Support from loved ones can mean a great deal. We believe that support should strengthen your voice, while keeping your wishes and consent at the centre.
web.mission.beingFarFromSri: Being far from Sri Lanka does not mean being far from your roots. Our vision includes people at home and abroad, with space for different experiences and shared belonging.
web.mission.aKindBeginningMatters: A kind beginning matters, even when a connection does not continue. Clear intentions, honest communication, and respect for a “no” are essential.
web.mission.theWeddingIsOne: The wedding is one day. Partnership is the everyday life that follows. We want to encourage conversations about the life you hope to share.
web.mission.findSomeoneWhoWants: Find someone who wants to build a future with you, one honest conversation at a time.

web.security.description: How Favorite Hearts protects your information, what our badges mean, how to keep your account safe, and how to report a security issue.
web.security.headline: A little care. A safer connection.
web.security.protectYourInformationRecog: Protect your information, recognise suspicious requests, and know where to turn if something feels wrong.
web.security.neverShareASign: Never share a sign-in code or a password with anyone: Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for them. Sign out of shared devices.
web.security.beCautiousWithUnexpected: Be cautious with unexpected links, downloads, or requests to sign in. Open the website yourself when you are unsure who sent a message.
web.security.keepIdentityDocumentsFinanc: Keep identity documents, financial details, and private contact information out of public profiles and social comments.
web.security.identityDocumentsReceiptsAn: Identity documents, receipts and original photos are kept in private storage and shown only through links that expire within minutes, to people allowed to see them. Identity documents are deleted 90 days after our review. Members who may not see a photo receive a separate blurred copy. Staff sign in with two-step login, sign-in and code attempts are limited, and a bot check guards the sign-in forms. Still, a badge is never a promise that a connection is risk-free.
web.security.ifYouNoticeA: If you notice a suspicious link, possible data exposure, or a weakness in the website, tell us privately.
web.security.thePageAddressAnd: The page address and a short description.
web.security.whatYouExpectedAnd: What you expected and what happened instead.
web.security.yourDeviceBrowserAnd: Your device, browser, and the approximate time.
web.security.aScreenshotWithPrivate: A screenshot with private information hidden, if useful.
web.security.doNotShareIt: Do not share it: Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for a password or a sign-in code. If you already shared a code, tell us straight away so we can help you secure your account, and tell us if the message claimed to be from Favorite Hearts.
web.security.noAnEncryptedConnection: No. An encrypted connection helps protect traffic in transit, but it does not prove that a person is genuine or that a request is safe. Check the website address and independently confirm unexpected requests.
web.security.noEachBadgeMeans: No. Each badge means one specific check was done: an identity document reviewed by our staff and a phone verified by SMS (“Manager verified”, “Candidate identity verified”), or a candidate confirming their own profile (“Candidate confirmed”). It is not a government verification, and no badge can guarantee someone’s intentions or future behaviour.
web.security.useReportOnTheir: Use Report on their profile in the app, and see our <link>Trust & Safety guidance</link>. If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services rather than waiting for a reply from us.
web.security.weCanHelpYou: We can help you find the right next step for a privacy or security enquiry.
web.security.someoneAskedForMy: Someone asked for my password or code. What should I do?
web.security.doesHttpsMeanA: Does HTTPS mean a person or payment request is trustworthy?
web.security.isAVerificationBadge: Is a verification badge a guarantee of safety?
web.security.whereDoIRaise: Where do I raise a concern about another person?

web.trust.description: How Favorite Hearts keeps introductions respectful: details shared only after both accept, blocking and reporting, what badges mean, and meeting safely.
web.trust.headline: Good connections. Respectful beginnings.
web.trust.yourComfortChoiceAnd: Your comfort, choice, and privacy matter at every step. Take your time, stay curious, and keep your boundaries clear.
web.trust.anIntroductionIsAn: An introduction is an invitation. Both people can say no, ask for time, or decide not to continue—without pressure or guilt.
web.trust.ifYouAreHelping: If you are helping a family member, explain who manages the profile or conversation. Their voice and wishes should remain central.
web.trust.representYourselfAccuratelyDo: Represent yourself accurately. Do not impersonate someone, mislead people about your intentions, or share someone else’s photos without permission.
web.trust.youDonTOwe:
You don’t owe anyone
your trust—or your money.
web.trust.requestsForMoneySecrecy: Requests for money, secrecy, urgent transfers, intimate images, or identity documents deserve caution. A convincing story or a familiar cultural background is not proof that a person is genuine. Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for your password or a code.
web.trust.fromFirstHelloTo:
From first hello
to meeting in person.
web.trust.contactDetailsSocialHandles: Contact details, social handles and the full photo gallery are shared only after both sides accept a request; until then the other photos are blurred, and the cover photo is shown only if you allow it. Visitors who are not signed in see no profiles at all.
web.trust.decideWhatYouAre: Decide what you are comfortable sharing. Keep your home address, financial information, passwords and sign-in codes private. Upload identity documents only on the verification page of the app: we never ask for them by WhatsApp or email. Be clear about your intentions and any family involvement.
web.trust.takeTimeToNotice: Take time to notice consistency between what someone says and does. Do not send money to someone you have only met online. You can stop a conversation if there is pressure, harassment, or repeated disregard for your boundaries.
web.trust.chooseAPublicPlace: Choose a public place, arrange your own transport, and tell someone you trust where you will be. Keep your phone available and make a plan to leave if you feel uncomfortable.
web.trust.youDoNotNeed: You do not need to justify a decision to step away. In the app you can end a connection or block a profile at any time, and Report sends it to our staff: a report about explicit content, a minor, threats or a scam hides the profile at once until we review it. Keep relevant messages if you want to raise a concern.
web.trust.askWhatKindOf: Ask what kind of help they want and respect their pace. Family enthusiasm does not replace personal willingness. Do not share private photos or contact details without appropriate permission.
web.trust.contactLocalEmergencyServices: Contact local emergency services and someone you trust. Favorite Hearts is not an emergency service.
web.trust.youCanSendA: You can send a message at any time.
web.trust.ifYouAreUnsure: If you are unsure where to begin, tell us what you need.
web.trust.whatStaysPrivateUntil: What stays private until you both accept
web.trust.ifYouAreSupporting: If you are supporting a family member
web.trust.useLeftAndRight: Use left and right arrow keys to browse introductions.
web.pricing.step1.title: Choose a plan in the app
web.pricing.step1.text: Pick a plan for the published profile. The app shows the price for the country you live in, and what changes if the profile already has a plan.
web.pricing.step2.title: Pay with your reference
web.pricing.step2.text: Send the exact amount to the account shown in the app: a bank transfer in Sri Lanka, or SWIFT, Wise or PayPal from abroad. Include the reference the app gives you.
web.pricing.step3.title: Upload the receipt
web.pricing.step3.text: Add a photo or screenshot of the receipt in the app. We look for your payment in our own bank, Wise or PayPal statement, within 48 hours.
web.pricing.step4.title: The plan starts
web.pricing.step4.text: The plan starts when we find your payment, not when the receipt arrives. We email you as soon as it is active.
web.pricing.q1: Do I need to pay to publish a profile?
web.pricing.a1: No. Creating and publishing a profile is free once the identity document is reviewed and the phone number is verified by SMS (for a profile a family member manages, the manager’s). Without a plan you can browse other published profiles and receive requests, but you cannot see who sent them, send requests or accept them, and you see no contact details.
web.pricing.a2: Sending requests (Starter: 5 a day and 30 a month; Premium: unlimited requests, fair use applies, up to 30 a day), seeing who is interested, accepting requests, and the contact details and social handles of the people you connect with once you have both accepted. There is no chat in the app.
web.pricing.a3: The price for the country you live in. If you live in Sri Lanka you pay in LKR by local bank transfer; anywhere else you pay in USD by international transfer (SWIFT), Wise or PayPal. Our team compares the country you declare with how you pay and with your reviewed document. A difference is checked by a person, never rejected automatically.
web.pricing.q4: Can a parent or family member pay?
web.pricing.a4: Yes. A plan belongs to one profile, so a family member who manages several profiles buys a plan for each. If the candidate later takes over the profile, the paid time stays with the profile.
web.pricing.a5: No. Nothing renews or charges you automatically. You can renew the same plan in its last 7 days; the new term counts from the day we approve the payment. If you send a renewal receipt before the plan ends, access continues for up to 3 days after the end while we check it.
web.pricing.q6: Can I change to another plan?
web.pricing.a6: You can move up to a higher plan at any time. It starts when we approve the payment, and the unused days of the current plan are lost: the app tells you exactly how many before you pay. A lower plan can be bought once the current plan has ended.
web.pricing.q7: What happens when a plan ends?
web.pricing.a7: You no longer see anyone’s contact details or social handles, including your connections’. Your connections stay, and their details come back when you renew. We email you 7 days before the end, on the last day, and once it has ended.
web.pricing.a8: There are no refunds once a plan is active, except for a duplicate payment, a payment made by mistake, or a failure on our side. You confirm that you have read this before you pay. If a payment is later reversed or disputed, for example through PayPal, the plan it paid for can be ended. If a profile is suspended for breaking our rules, the remaining time is lost. Marking a profile engaged or married, or deleting it, also ends its plan without a refund.
web.pricing.q9: How do I ask about a payment I have made?
web.pricing.a9: Contact us with the payment reference (FH followed by six letters and numbers) and a short description. Never send passwords, codes or full bank statements: Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for them.
web.pricing.q10: Is there chat or horoscope matching?
web.pricing.a10: No. Once both sides accept, contact details are shared so you can continue in your own way. Horoscope matching is not offered; a profile can say how important horoscope matching is to the family.
web.help.started.name: Getting started
web.help.started.a1: Favorite Hearts is a matrimony service for Sri Lankans in Sri Lanka and around the world, for people looking for marriage. It is not a dating app and has no chat. Our mission is to make life less lonely by bringing people together to build happy families.
web.help.started.a2: Adults aged 18 and over who are considering marriage, and the parents, guardians or family members who help them. The candidate’s own wishes always come first.
web.help.started.a3: Choose <link>Join now</link>. You sign in with a 6-digit code sent to your email or phone, and the first code also creates your account. Favorite Hearts staff will never ask you for a code.
web.help.started.q4: How does a profile get published?
web.help.started.a4: Publishing is free. It needs a complete profile and two checks: an identity document (NIC, passport or driving licence) reviewed by our staff, and a phone number verified by SMS. For a profile a family member manages, the manager’s document and phone are checked. We aim to review documents within 48 hours.
web.help.started.q5: Can I join if I live outside Sri Lanka?
web.help.started.a5: Yes. Members abroad use the same app and pay in USD; members in Sri Lanka pay in LKR. Where you live, and where you would like to settle, are good things to discuss early.
web.help.started.q6: What do the badges on a profile mean?
web.help.started.a6: Manager verified: the family member who manages the profile had their identity document reviewed and their phone verified. Candidate confirmed: the candidate accepted the profile themselves. Candidate identity verified: the candidate’s own identity document was reviewed. A badge means that check was done. It is not a government verification and cannot guarantee anyone’s intentions.
web.help.profiles.name: Profiles & family
web.help.profiles.q1: Can a parent or family member create a profile?
web.help.profiles.a1: Yes. A parent, guardian or other family member can create and manage a profile for a candidate, up to 3 profiles each. They confirm that the candidate is 18 or older and has agreed to the profile and to their details being shared after mutual acceptance.
web.help.profiles.q2: How does the candidate join a profile a family member made?
web.help.profiles.a2: The manager sends an invitation to the candidate’s own email or phone. The link works once, expires after 24 hours, and needs a code sent to that address. The candidate can confirm the profile, choose what the manager may do and what is shared, decline it, or take it over and manage it alone at any time. A profile that is taken over keeps its plan, and the manager loses access straight away.
web.help.profiles.q3: What should I include in a profile?
web.help.profiles.a3: Share an honest introduction, your interests, and what you hope for in a partnership. Details about education, work, and everyday life can help someone start a meaningful conversation.
web.help.profiles.a4: Up to 5 recent, clear photos of the candidate, one of them the cover. You choose whether other members see the cover photo; the other photos stay blurred for everyone until you both accept a request. The blurred copies are made on our server, so an original is never sent to someone who may not see it. Use only photos you have permission to share.
web.help.profiles.q5: How do I change my profile?
web.help.profiles.a5: In the app: the profile’s details, photos and contact details can be changed at any time by the people allowed to edit it. Never send identity documents by WhatsApp or email; upload them only on the app’s verification page.
web.help.profiles.q6: Can I hide my profile for a while?
web.help.profiles.a6: Yes. Pause hides the profile from other members at any time, and you can publish it again later. If you are engaged or married, mark the profile engaged or married: it is hidden and its plan ends, and the remaining time is not refunded.
web.help.profiles.q7: Does a family introduction mean I have to continue?
web.help.profiles.a7: No. An introduction is an invitation. Both people should feel free to ask for time, set boundaries, or decide that the connection is not right for them.
web.help.introductions.name: Introductions
web.help.introductions.a1: A profile with a plan sends a request, and the other side accepts or declines. Only when both have accepted are you connected and contact details shared. A declined request unlocks nothing.
web.help.introductions.q2: What is shared once we both accept?
web.help.introductions.a2: The contact details and social handles of the candidate and of the family member who manages the profile, the full photo gallery, and the parents’ names. The candidate can choose in the privacy settings which contact details are shared. Details someone has already seen cannot be taken back.
web.help.introductions.q3: Can I receive requests without a plan?
web.help.introductions.a3: Yes. Without a plan you see that a request arrived, with the sender’s age and occupation, but not who sent it. To see the sender and to accept, the profile needs a plan.
web.help.introductions.q4: How many requests can I send?
web.help.introductions.a4: Starter: 5 a day and 30 a month. Premium: unlimited requests, fair use applies, up to 30 a day. A day starts at midnight Sri Lanka time. Each request counts once, even if it is later withdrawn or declined.
web.help.introductions.q5: Can I send another request after a no?
web.help.introductions.a5: After a decline, a withdrawn request or an ended connection, either side can send a new request to the other after 7 days.
web.help.introductions.q6: Is there chat inside Favorite Hearts?
web.help.introductions.a6: No. Once both sides accept, contact details are shared so you can continue in your own way.
web.help.introductions.a7: Yes, at any time. Both sides lose access to each other’s details from that moment. You can also block a profile, which hides each of you from the other.
web.help.introductions.q8: What should we talk about first?
web.help.introductions.a8: Begin with everyday life, what matters to each of you, and the future you hope to build. You do not need to settle every important question in the first conversation.
web.help.payments.name: Payments
web.help.payments.q1: Do I need to pay to publish a profile?
web.help.payments.a1: No. Publishing is free once you are verified. A plan lets the profile send requests, see who is interested and accept requests. See <link>plans and prices</link>.
web.help.payments.a2: By transfer, never automatically. You choose a plan in the app, pay the exact amount with the reference the app gives you, and upload a photo or screenshot of the receipt. The plan starts once we find your payment in our bank, Wise or PayPal statement: a receipt alone is not enough. We aim to check payments within 48 hours.
web.help.payments.a3: There are no refunds once a plan is active, except for a duplicate payment, a payment made by mistake, or a failure on our side. The details are on the <link>pricing page</link> and in our <link2>terms</link2>.
web.help.payments.q4: Can I ask about a payment I have made?
web.help.payments.a4: Yes. Contact us with the payment reference (FH followed by six letters and numbers). Never send passwords, codes, card numbers or full bank statements.
web.help.payments.q5: Where can I see the prices?
web.help.payments.a5: On the <link>pricing page</link>, and in the app when you choose a plan. Do not rely on prices in social media comments or in messages from other people.
web.help.privacy.name: Privacy & safety
web.help.privacy.a1: Only signed-in members whose own identity check is complete can browse published profiles. Visitors who are not signed in see no profiles at all. Contact details and the full photo gallery are shared only after both sides accept.
web.help.privacy.q2: Do I have to give my caste or religion?
web.help.privacy.a2: No. Both are optional, with “Prefer not to say”. Caste is saved only with your explicit consent, is shown only to signed-in members, and can be removed at any time. Income is optional, shown as a range and labelled self-declared.
web.help.privacy.q3: Will Favorite Hearts ever ask for my password or code?
web.help.privacy.a3: Never. Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for a password or a sign-in code, by phone, WhatsApp, email or anywhere else. Anyone who asks is not us.
web.help.privacy.a4: Use Report on their profile. A report about explicit content, a minor, threats or a scam hides the profile at once until our staff review it; other reports hide it once three different verified members report it. Staff restore anything hidden by mistake. You can also block the profile. If you are in danger, contact local emergency services.
web.help.privacy.q5: What if someone asks me for money?
web.help.privacy.a5: Do not send money to someone you have only met online. Stop and seek support if a person pressures you to pay, invest, share bank details, or keep financial requests secret.
web.help.privacy.q6: How should I prepare for a first meeting?
web.help.privacy.a6: Choose a public place, arrange your own transport, and tell someone you trust where you are going. Meet at a pace you feel comfortable with and leave if you feel uneasy.
web.help.privacy.q7: How long do you keep my information?
web.help.privacy.a7: Identity documents are deleted 90 days after the review. When you delete a profile or your account it disappears at once, and a short list of records, such as payment records, reports and blocks, is kept for 6 months and then deleted. The <link>privacy policy</link> lists everything.
web.help.privacy.q8: Can I download or delete my data?
web.help.privacy.a8: Yes. In the app, Your account has Download my data (one ZIP file with your profiles, contact details, photos, requests, connections and payments) and Delete my account. For anything else, email <link>{email}</link> with the subject “Privacy request”.
web.help.nfaq.name: NFAQ
web.help.nfaq.heading: Not-so frequently asked questions
web.help.nfaq.a1: Not-so frequently asked questions: the things you might be wondering about, even if they do not come up in every conversation.
web.help.nfaq.q2: Do we need to agree on everything?
web.help.nfaq.a2: No two people are identical. What matters is having room to talk honestly about differences, understand each other’s priorities, and decide what you can build together.
web.help.nfaq.q3: What if my family and I want different things?
web.help.nfaq.a3: Try explaining what matters to you and the kind of support you would welcome. Family can offer perspective, but your own willingness should never be replaced by pressure.
web.help.nfaq.q4: Does Favorite Hearts guarantee a marriage?
web.help.nfaq.a4: No. A meaningful partnership depends on the people involved. Introductions can create opportunities, but neither a profile nor a plan can guarantee a relationship or marriage.
web.help.nfaq.a5: No. A profile can say how important horoscope matching is to the family, so you can talk about it, but Favorite Hearts does not match horoscopes.
web.help.nfaq.q6: When can I contact the team?
web.help.nfaq.a6: Our support hours are daily, 8:00 AM–10:00 PM, Sri Lanka time. You can call or send a WhatsApp message to 076 676 9894, or email us; messages outside those hours are answered when we are back. Favorite Hearts is not an emergency service.

web.terms.about.title: About these terms
web.terms.about.1: These terms are an agreement between you and the operator of Favorite Hearts, <operator/> (“we”, “us”). They apply when you use the Favorite Hearts website or app, create an account, run a profile or buy a plan. If you do not agree, please do not use Favorite Hearts.
web.terms.about.2: The English text is the official version. A Sinhala translation is provided for convenience; if the two differ, the English text applies.
web.terms.service.title: What Favorite Hearts is
web.terms.service.1: Favorite Hearts is a matrimony service for adults who are looking for marriage, in Sri Lanka and abroad. It is not a dating service and it has no chat. We help people find each other; we do not arrange marriages, and we cannot guarantee a match, a relationship or a marriage.
web.terms.eligibility.title: Who may use it
web.terms.eligibility.1: You must be 18 or older. A profile may only be created for an adult who is looking for marriage.
web.terms.eligibility.2: You may hold one account. Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for your password or a sign-in code.
web.terms.accounts.title: Your account and verification
web.terms.accounts.1: You sign in with a code sent to your email or phone. Keep them private: you are responsible for what is done with your account.
web.terms.accounts.2: A profile is published only after the identity document of the person who runs it (NIC, passport or driving licence) has been reviewed by our staff and their phone number has been verified by SMS. The badges on a profile mean exactly this:
web.terms.accounts.3: Manager verified: the family member who manages the profile had their identity document reviewed and their phone verified.
web.terms.accounts.4: Candidate confirmed: the candidate accepted the profile themselves.
web.terms.accounts.5: Candidate identity verified: the candidate’s own identity document was reviewed.
web.terms.accounts.6: A badge is not a government verification and does not guarantee anyone’s identity or intentions. Upload identity documents only through the verification page of the app: we never accept them by WhatsApp, email or any other way.
web.terms.managers.title: Running a profile for someone else
web.terms.managers.1: A parent, guardian or other family member may create and manage a profile for a candidate, up to 3 profiles unless we agree to more. By creating one, you confirm that the candidate is 18 or older, that they have given you permission to create the profile, and that they agree to their contact details being shared with members they connect with, as described below.
web.terms.managers.2: Until the candidate confirms the profile, their details are shared on your word, and a phone number you entered for them is shown as “not verified by candidate”. You must hide or delete the profile, or stop sharing their details, as soon as the candidate asks.
web.terms.managers.3: The candidate can join the profile by invitation at any time, choose what you may do and what is shared, have it hidden, take it over, or delete it. When a candidate takes the profile over, you lose all access to it straight away, your own contact details are removed from it, and any paid time stays with the profile.
web.terms.connections.title: Requests, connections and sharing
web.terms.connections.1: A profile with a plan can send requests. A connection is made only when both sides accept; a declined request unlocks nothing.
web.terms.connections.2: Once both sides accept, the contact details and social handles of the candidate and of the family member who manages the profile, the full photo gallery and the parents’ names are shared with the other side. The candidate can limit which contact details are shared in the privacy settings. Details that have been shared cannot be taken back.
web.terms.connections.3: Either side can end a connection or block a profile at any time; access to each other’s details ends from that moment. After a decline, a withdrawn request or an ended connection, a new request between the same two profiles can be sent after 7 days.
web.terms.connections.4: You may use the contact details you receive only to get to know that person with a view to marriage. Do not pass them on or use them for anything else.
web.terms.plans.title: Plans and prices
web.terms.plans.1: Creating and publishing a profile is free. A plan lets a profile send requests, see who sent requests to it, and accept requests. Each profile has its own plan.
web.terms.plans.2: The plans, their length, their limits and their prices are shown on our <link>pricing page</link> and in the app. Starter allows 5 requests a day and 30 a month. Premium is offered as unlimited requests, fair use applies: it allows up to 30 requests a day. A day starts at midnight Sri Lanka time. A request counts when it is sent, even if it is later withdrawn or declined.
web.terms.plans.3: If you live in Sri Lanka you pay the local price in LKR; if you live anywhere else you pay the overseas price in USD. You must state the country you live in truthfully. We may compare it with how you pay and with your reviewed document, and ask you about a difference.
web.terms.plans.4: We may change our plans and prices. A change never affects a plan that is already paid for.
web.terms.payments.title: Paying
web.terms.payments.1: You pay by bank transfer in Sri Lanka, or by international transfer (SWIFT), Wise or PayPal from abroad, to the details shown in the app, with the unique reference the app gives you. You then upload a photo or screenshot of the receipt.
web.terms.payments.2: A plan starts only when we have found your payment in our own bank, Wise or PayPal statement; a receipt alone is not enough. We aim to check payments within 48 hours. If we cannot match a payment, we tell you why.
web.terms.payments.3: Plans never renew automatically, and we never take a payment without your action.
web.terms.changes.title: Changing, renewing and ending a plan
web.terms.changes.1: You may move to a higher plan at any time. It starts when we approve the payment, and the unused days of your current plan are lost; the app shows exactly how many before you pay. A lower plan can be bought once the current plan has ended.
web.terms.changes.2: You may renew the same plan in its last 7 days. The new term counts from the day we approve the payment. If you send a renewal receipt before the plan ends, access continues for up to 3 days after the end while we check it.
web.terms.changes.3: When a plan ends, you can no longer see anyone’s contact details or social handles, including your connections’. Your connections remain, and their details become visible again when you renew. We remind you before a plan ends.
web.terms.refunds.title: Refunds, disputes and lost time
web.terms.refunds.1: There are no refunds once a plan is active, except for:
web.terms.refunds.5: You confirm that you have read this before you pay.
web.terms.refunds.6: If a payment is reversed or disputed after the plan started, for example through PayPal, we may end the plan it paid for.
web.terms.refunds.7: If we suspend a profile for breaking these terms, its remaining plan time is lost. If you mark a profile engaged or married, or delete it or your account, its plan ends and the remaining time is not refunded.
web.terms.refunds.8: Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under consumer protection law.
web.terms.conduct.title: How you must behave
web.terms.conduct.1: Be honest about yourself and about the candidate. Do not impersonate anyone, or create a profile for someone without their permission.
web.terms.conduct.2: Never create or manage a profile for anyone under 18.
web.terms.conduct.3: Do not harass, threaten or deceive anyone, ask anyone for money, or send explicit content.
web.terms.conduct.4: Use Favorite Hearts only to look for a marriage partner, not to sell, advertise or recruit.
web.terms.conduct.5: Do not copy profiles, collect members’ information, or try to get around our access rules, limits or security.
web.terms.safety.title: Reports and moderation
web.terms.safety.1: Any verified member can report a profile or a photo. A report about explicit content, a minor, threats or a scam hides it at once; any other report hides it once three different verified members have reported it. Our staff review everything that is hidden, restore it if it was hidden by mistake, and may warn, suspend or remove a member who breaks these terms. Repeated false reporting has consequences.
web.terms.safety.2: If you are worried about someone’s safety, contact local emergency services first. Favorite Hearts is not an emergency service.
web.terms.content.title: Your content
web.terms.content.1: You are responsible for what you add to a profile, including photos you have permission to share. You keep your rights in it, and you allow us to store it and to show it to other members as these terms and our <link>privacy policy</link> describe, for as long as it is on Favorite Hearts.
web.terms.content.2: Photos are shown blurred to anyone who may not yet see them; we make the blurred copies.
web.terms.content.3: The Favorite Hearts name, design and text belong to us or to those who licensed them to us.
web.terms.ending.title: Pausing, deleting and leaving
web.terms.ending.1: You can pause a profile, mark it engaged or married, delete a profile, or delete your whole account at any time in the app. Deleting needs a recent sign-in.
web.terms.ending.2: A deleted profile disappears at once. What is deleted, what we keep and for how long is set out in our <link>privacy policy</link>.
web.terms.ending.3: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, after reviewing it.
web.terms.liability.title: Our responsibility
web.terms.liability.1: We work to keep Favorite Hearts available, accurate and secure, but we cannot promise that it will always be available or free of errors. We are not responsible for what members do outside Favorite Hearts, including when they meet. Meet in a public place and tell someone you trust.
web.terms.liability.2: Any limit on our responsibility applies only as far as the law allows, and nothing in these terms limits a responsibility that the law does not allow to be limited.
web.terms.law.title: Changes, law and contact
web.terms.law.1: We may update these terms. We tell members about important changes before they take effect; continuing to use Favorite Hearts after that means you accept them.
web.terms.law.2: These terms are governed by the laws of Sri Lanka, and the courts of Sri Lanka decide any dispute about them, without removing any protection the law of the country you live in gives you.
web.terms.law.3: Questions about these terms: <operator/>, <email/>, or WhatsApp and calls on 076 676 9894.

web.privacy.about.title: About this policy
web.privacy.about.1: This policy explains how <operator/> (“we”, “us”) collects, uses, shares and keeps personal information when you use the Favorite Hearts website and app. The English text is the official version.
web.privacy.about.2: For any question or request about your information, email <email/> with the subject “Privacy request”.
web.privacy.collect.title: What we collect
web.privacy.collect.1: Your account: your name, your email address and/or phone number, and your sign-in. Sign-in codes expire after 10 minutes.
web.privacy.collect.2: Profiles you run: the details you enter, such as gender, date of birth, where the candidate lives, education, occupation, height, marital status, languages, family details, an introduction, values and interests; up to 5 photos; contact details and social handles.
web.privacy.collect.3: Optional sensitive details: religion, caste and income range. Each is optional, with “Prefer not to say”. Caste is saved only with your explicit consent and can be removed at any time; income is shown as a range labelled self-declared.
web.privacy.collect.4: Verification: a photo of your identity document (NIC, passport or driving licence), your verified phone number, and our review decision.
web.privacy.collect.5: Activity: requests, connections, blocks, reports, plan history, and a record of which kinds of details were shared with whom and when (the kinds, never the details themselves).
web.privacy.collect.6: Payments: the country you live in, the plan, amount, payment method and reference, the receipt photos or screenshots you upload, the matching line of our statement, and our decision.
web.privacy.collect.7: Messages you send us, and the emails we send you.
web.privacy.collect.8: Technical information: your IP address and device details, used for security and to limit abuse.
web.privacy.use.title: How we use it
web.privacy.use.1: We use your information to run Favorite Hearts: to publish and show profiles, send and answer requests, share details after both sides accept, review identity documents and phone numbers, check payments, send you emails about your account (sign-in codes, invitations, payment decisions and plan reminders), keep members safe (reports, moderation, limits on attempts and a bot check), and meet our legal obligations.
web.privacy.use.2: We do not sell personal information, we do not show advertising, and we do not use your information for anything unrelated to finding a marriage partner.
web.privacy.sharing.title: Who sees what
web.privacy.sharing.1: Visitors who are not signed in see no profiles at all.
web.privacy.sharing.2: Signed-in members whose own identity check is complete can see published profiles: the age (never the date of birth), the details the profile shows, caste only if you consented, the cover photo only if you allow it, and the other photos blurred.
web.privacy.sharing.3: A member without a plan who receives a request sees the sender’s age and occupation, not who sent it.
web.privacy.sharing.4: Once both sides accept a request, each side sees the other’s contact details and social handles (the candidate’s and the managing family member’s), the full photo gallery and the parents’ names. The candidate can limit which contact details are shared. Details that have been shared cannot be taken back.
web.privacy.sharing.5: The people who run a profile (the candidate and a managing family member) see it according to the permissions the candidate sets.
web.privacy.sharing.6: Our staff: the owner and one backup reviewer, each with two-step sign-in. The backup reviewer reviews documents and reports and has no access to payments. Every look at an identity document or a receipt is logged.
web.privacy.providers.title: Service providers and where your information is processed
web.privacy.providers.1: We use these providers to run Favorite Hearts. They process information only to provide their service to us:
web.privacy.providers.3: Cloudflare: website hosting, private file storage (R2), and the Turnstile bot check on sign-in forms.
web.privacy.providers.5: Pexels: some photos on the public website are loaded from the Pexels image library, so your browser contacts Pexels to show them.
web.privacy.providers.6: An SMS provider for sign-in and verification codes, and a host for our application server; both will be named here before launch.
web.privacy.providers.7: Your information is therefore stored and processed outside Sri Lanka. We share information with authorities only when the law requires it.
web.privacy.security.title: How we protect it
web.privacy.security.1: Connections are encrypted. Identity documents, receipts and original photos are kept in private storage and are shown only through links that expire within minutes, and only to people allowed to see them. Members who may not yet see a photo receive a separate blurred copy. Staff sign in with two-step login, and sign-in and code attempts are limited. Favorite Hearts staff will never ask for your password or a code.
web.privacy.security.2: No system is perfectly secure. If you notice something wrong, tell us at once.
web.privacy.retention.title: How long we keep it
web.privacy.retention.1: Identity documents are deleted 90 days after our review, whether approved or rejected. After that we keep only the document type, the reviewer, the date and the decision.
web.privacy.retention.2: While your account is open, we keep your information for as long as it is needed to run the service.
web.privacy.retention.3: When you delete a profile, it disappears at once. Its details, photos, contact details, social handles, requests, connections and shortlists are deleted at once. Its payment records and receipts, plan history, reports and blocks, and our staff’s record of their actions are kept for 6 months, then deleted.
web.privacy.retention.4: When you delete your account, every profile you run is deleted as above, except a profile whose candidate has joined it, which passes to the candidate. Your name, email address and phone number are removed from the account at once, your identity document is deleted at once, and you are signed out everywhere. For 6 months we keep only the records listed above and a scrambled form of your email address and phone number, used only to stop a banned person from signing up again. Then they are deleted too.
web.privacy.retention.5: Details already shared with your connections cannot be taken back from them.
web.privacy.rights.title: Your choices and rights
web.privacy.rights.1: See and download: Download my data in the app gives you one file with your profiles, contact details, photos, requests, connections and payments.
web.privacy.rights.2: Correct: edit your profile in the app at any time.
web.privacy.rights.3: Delete: delete a profile or your account in the app.
web.privacy.rights.4: Withdraw consent or limit sharing: remove your caste, choose which contact details connections receive, or pause the profile.
web.privacy.rights.5: For anything else, email <email/> with the subject “Privacy request”. We may ask you to confirm that the request comes from you. You may also complain to the data protection authority of the country you live in.
web.privacy.children.title: Under 18s
web.privacy.children.1: Favorite Hearts is only for adults. If you believe a profile belongs to someone under 18, report it: it is hidden at once while our staff review it.
web.privacy.storage.title: Cookies and storage in your browser
web.privacy.storage.1: When you sign in, the app sets one cookie that keeps you signed in. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.
web.privacy.storage.2: The website remembers your language and country if you choose them, and the app remembers whether you prefer the light or dark theme. Both stay in your browser.
web.privacy.storage.3: On sign-in and code forms, Cloudflare Turnstile checks that you are a person; Cloudflare processes technical information about your browser to do this.
web.privacy.changes.title: Changes and contact
web.privacy.changes.1: We will update this policy when our practices change and show the new date at the top. We tell members about important changes before they take effect.
web.privacy.changes.2: Contact: <operator/>, <email/>, or WhatsApp and calls on 076 676 9894.
web.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
web.privacy.description: What we collect, who can see it, how it is protected, and what is kept, and for how long, after you delete a profile or account. Draft awaiting legal review.
